She would’ve never been after being treated that way by her life partner. He bows to his Empress. If only he could tell her how deserving of love she was. His precious Lilian was the only person able to paint his world with colors. He smiled softly.*

"Your highness, let me escort you to your apartments, I shall ensure your safety on the way."

*He offers his hand, a sweet, gentle and friendly gesture.*

"I shall always believe you. My loyalty is yours alone, my Empress. If you had intended to kill the Queen Consort, there would be nothing linking you to the crime. You are far too intelligent and composed for that."

*He adds, comforting and joking softly.*
